He is 19-3 with a KO of CJ Vergara on his ledger, and the Elo parity says the ratings system rates him Erceg's equal. But he must close a -1.73 reach deficit against a busier, fresher opponent to use any of it, and 506 days of inactivity is the opposite of the profile that usually solves that problem.
